name: pursestring
description: Spending guardrails for AI agents: your rules, and a human when needed, checked before money moves.
long_description: PurseString sits between your AI agent and your money. The agent submits a purchase intent; PurseString checks it against your policies.yaml (vendor allowlist, per-transaction and daily limits, monthly caps for recurring spend) and auto-approves, denies, or asks a human. Only an approved intent gets a single-use virtual card capped to the approved amount, or a PayPal payout to the vendor account in your policy. With no keys it runs on the mock rail, so cards are fake and no money moves. It is not a payment gateway or wallet: it holds no funds and stops payments before money moves.

tools.name: check_policy_compliance
tools.description: Dry-run a purchase against your policy without creating an intent.

tools.name: submit_purchase_intent
tools.description: Ask to spend: returns approved, denied, or pending a human.

tools.name: request_ephemeral_card
tools.description: Get a single-use card capped to an approved intent's amount.

tools.name: send_payment
tools.description: Pay an approved intent to the vendor's PayPal or Venmo account set in your policy.

tools.name: get_intent_status
tools.description: Check an intent's status, for example after a human decides.

tools.name: x402_fetch
tools.description: Fetch an https resource that charges per request (HTTP 402), paying in USDC only when policy allows. Listed only when x402 is enabled in policies.yaml.

policy_file.title: Policy file (optional)
policy_file.description: Your policies.yaml. Leave empty to use ~/.pursestring/policies.yaml or the safe defaults.

lithic_api_key.title: Lithic API key (optional)
lithic_api_key.description: Turns on Lithic virtual cards (sandbox by default). Leave empty for the mock rail.

paypal_client_id.title: PayPal client ID (optional)
paypal_client_id.description: Turns on PayPal payouts (sandbox by default).

paypal_client_secret.title: PayPal client secret (optional)
paypal_client_secret.description: Needed with the PayPal client ID.
